metadata.description: Agent evals, guardrails and research skills by Oren Segal: mutation testing for eval suites, citation checking, guard hooks for Claude Code, codebase audit, and customer-signal research. Each plugin lives in its own repo.

plugins.name: litmus
plugins.description: Mutation testing for LLM and agent eval suites. Can your eval fail? Breaks the skill on purpose and checks the evals notice.

plugins.name: cited
plugins.description: Re-fetches every cited source and flags claims that are not on the page.

plugins.name: sous
plugins.description: sous-guard PreToolUse hook, the test-audit and prune-tests skills and tests-ran. Run `sous install` for permissions, sandbox and ask gates.

plugins.name: blast-shield
plugins.description: Mod: holds risky shell commands (rm, git reset/clean/force-push, kubectl, terraform, docker, SQL), shows what they would change and whether it can be undone, and runs them only on Proceed. Apache-2.0 fork of Anthropic's Blast Radius; see plugins/blast-shield/NOTICE.

plugins.name: scoped
plugins.description: File claims between concurrent Claude Code sessions, enforced by a PreToolUse hook.

plugins.name: deuce
plugins.description: Post-merge cleanup: finds merged branches, dry-runs the sweep, then removes worktrees and local and remote branches on approval, with an audit log and undo.

plugins.name: architecture-lint
plugins.description: Module-boundary linter with a ratchet baseline: fails CI only when the count of forbidden imports or singletons grows.

plugins.name: codebase-audit
plugins.description: Adversarial codebase audit against fourteen engineering fundamentals: routes lenses by detected stack, has serious findings challenged by a refuter, scores every fundamental and clusters findings by root cause, plus an untangle refactor.

plugins.name: signal-scout
plugins.description: Turns a startup URL or product description into an evidence-backed shortlist of first customers, market segments, and companies worth pitching.

plugins.name: podcast
plugins.description: Mine podcasts (Apple Podcasts, RSS, YouTube, or by show name) into extracted findings, predictions, and a queryable corpus.

plugins.name: review-scout
plugins.description: Mine app/store/web reviews into ranked findings, regressions, and feature-request clusters.

plugins.name: ideation
plugins.description: Turn podcast/review-scout findings into prioritized, cited build-next proposals.

plugins.name: signal-report
plugins.description: Render ranked findings into a themed, shareable report.

plugins.name: signal-outreach
plugins.description: Turn a signal-scout prospect report into ready-to-send outreach sequences, content briefs, and BD pitches.

plugins.name: visibility
plugins.description: Ship it where builders look: get your MCP server, agent plugin, skill, SDK or API listed in the registries, marketplaces and package indexes developers and agents actually search.

plugins.name: emil-design-swiftui
plugins.description: Unofficial SwiftUI adaptation of Emil Kowalski's design-engineering and animation skills for native iOS apps. Credit for the design judgment is Emil's; he did not write, review or endorse this port.
